input.short_description: Create and list transform steps via the v2 REST API.
input.body:
Transforms endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

Create and manage transform steps within pipelines. Transform steps are applied in order between source and destination connectors to filter, map, or enrich events.

Create a transform

POST /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=pipeline_idstringYesID of the pipeline to add the transform to.namestringYesHuman-readable name for the transform step.typestringYesOne of filter, map, enrich, or aggregate.configobjectYesType-specific configuration, e.g. filter predicates or mapping rules.positionintegerNoPosition in the transform chain. If omitted, appends to the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\" \\\n -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n -d '{\n \"name\": \"filter-premium-orders\",\n \"type\": \"filter\",\n \"config\": { \"predicate\": \"event.amount > 100\" }\n }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — returns an ordered array of transform steps configured for the pipeline.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}

Transform order and execution

Transforms are executed sequentially in the order they appear in the pipeline. Events flow left-to-right: source → transform[0] → transform[1] → ... → destination. Reorder transforms by updating a pipeline's transforms array directly.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Transform failures|body_html=

If a transform step fails (e.g. due to a malformed predicate), the event is logged as an error and does not flow to the destination. Review pipeline logs for details.

}}

Transform types

Filter

Exclude events matching a predicate. Events that do not match are passed through unchanged.

Map

Transform event fields using a mapping expression. Commonly used to rename, nest, or flatten fields.

Enrich

Add new fields to an event by joining with external data or applying a lookup.

Aggregate

Combine multiple events into a single event over a time window or count-based trigger.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Testing transforms|body_html=

Test your transform configuration against sample events before deploying to a live pipeline. Use the pipeline preview endpoint to validate the transform chain end-to-end.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a transform
  • List transforms
  • Transform order and execution
  • Transform types
    • }}

If omitted, appends to the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \\\n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\n -d '{\n "name": "filter-premium-orders",\n "type": "filter",\n "config": { "predicate": "event.amount > 100" }\n }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — returns an ordered array of transform steps configured for the pipeline.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

Transform order and execution

Transforms are executed sequentially in the order they appear in the pipeline. Events flow left-to-right: source → transform[0] → transform[1] → ... → destination. Reorder transforms by updating a pipeline's transforms array directly.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Transform failures|body_html=

If a transform step fails (e.g. due to a malformed predicate), the event is logged as an error and does not flow to the destination. Review pipeline logs for details.

}}

Transform types

Filter

Exclude events matching a predicate. Events that do not match are passed through unchanged.

Map

Transform event fields using a mapping expression. Commonly used to rename, nest, or flatten fields.

Enrich

Add new fields to an event by joining with external data or applying a lookup.

Aggregate

Combine multiple events into a single event over a time window or count-based trigger.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Testing transforms|body_html=

Test your transform configuration against sample events before deploying to a live pipeline. Use the pipeline preview endpoint to validate the transform chain end-to-end.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
